svg.title: How eyeful reviews a change
svg.desc: One line from the diff to the report. eyeful finds the project's commands from the manifests in the change's snapshot with rules, and the user confirms them; the checkout is set up and linted, triage sets files aside, the test suite runs on the change, and on the base where it fails, and the plan picks experts. The experts are the one place the review fans out: they review in parallel with read-only tools, and Jev merges their findings. For each error or warning a test can show, an agent writes a test that runs five times on the change and once on the base; it blocks only when the expected behaviour comes from a specification, an existing test or a crash, and a separate agent's fix is attached but never decides. A judge then reads what did not run. The report labels each comment and is written as Markdown and SARIF.
